_comment: Phase 2c acceptance targets (speaker counting on the broader set),
checked by acceptance.py against a run_suite.py report from the Linux
CPU reference container made with SET=standard, on top of every
phase2b_acceptance.json are checked as well). The labels-per-speaker
target is a band: the old 'at most 1.2' could not catch
under-counting. Speaker counts are judged against the reference
speakers with at least 5 s of speech in the streamed part
(replay.config min_speaker_sec). A missed target is reported by how

labels per real speaker between 0.8 and.note: mean over meetings of labels minted / reference speakers with >= 5 s of speech

classroom: at least 80% of questions get.note: settled labels, majority label over each question

diarization real-time factor at most 0.2.note: margin under the 0.3 ceiling of Phase 2a on other hardware
